# FormKit hosted synthetic study (v1)
New study, not the historical Mac fixture or a continuation of its samples. Public synthetic data only. Four production builds share the exact locked input graph and one leaf declaration model: vanilla text, required/minimum-three text, or an explicit list of five-field groups. Counts are 450 and 1500 text inputs. Both Marionette arms are built from 660d5beb with and without the exact v4 initial placement patch and consume physical packed output. Framework peers and FormKit are pinned by this directory's separate npm lock. No Pro, private data, API traffic, or user hardware.

This first stage is correctness only. Each arm/workload starts a fresh sandbox-enabled Chromium process, verifies the actual launch switches, tests real input, checks Core leaf and aggregate form values, and checks label/ID order, field identity, target error messaging where applicable, and full teardown. It must pass all 24 cells before a separate timing stage can run. This stage intentionally produces no performance metrics.

Predeclared timing plan after gate: same standard GitHub macos-15 launcher, one serial host, fresh browser process per sample, one excluded warmup per arm/workload, eight measured repetitions per cell in two balanced Williams squares with four fixed arms, no workload retries; retain per-cell errors including infrastructure failures, exact versions and pack/browser hashes. Primary latency is mount-start to first valid Core commit after a trusted edit; also report mount return, first-edit settlement, subsequent edit settlement and destruction separately. Do not compare absolute times directly to the previous user-Mac samples.
